Charlotte.title: Charlotte
Charlotte.content:
Charlotte
Role:: player (MC)
Location::
Seen In:: 2025-07-22
Status:: no
Type:: player

Background
Graphic designer, quiet loner, insomnia sufferer
Charlotte was born in Townia, raised by her grandmother in the northernmost house of the town. Her parents left when she was a baby — no one talks about them much. When she was 9, she left with her grandmother to the city after a “strange accident” at the quarry. She’s never remembered what happened — only that there was fog.
She hasn’t returned since.
Until now.

Recent Activity
The Nightmares Begin
Months ago, Charlotte began having vivid, repeating nightmares:

Always set in a fog-covered version of Townia
Always following a child’s voice she never sees
Always ending with a massive eye opening beneath her

The dreams worsened — insomnia followed, and her grip on reality began to fray. Her last sketch at work was of a lighthouse she didn’t remember drawing.
She finally gave in and returned to Townia — desperate for answers, or peace.
Arrived to town

Notes

Fog exposure: no
Memory loss: no

Location/Blacksmith.title: Blacksmith
Location/Blacksmith.content:
Located near the quarry. Provide tools for mine exchange for iron and copper.
Purpose: purchase or order tools, jewels or custom order.

Location/Grandma-House.title: Grandma House
Location/Grandma-House.content:
old abandoned house at northern most part of the town. Previous owner passed away and never been own by anyone. Occasionally get clean by the tavern owner’s daughter.
Purpose: Charlotte’s home.

Location/Lighthouse.title: Lighthouse
Location/Lighthouse.content: at west, on the highest slope of the town. Lived by lighthouse keeper, and old man in his 50’s.

Location/Logger.title: Logger
Location/Logger.content: Located close by to the farm. A family of 3 lived there, making a living out of wood cutting and carpentry.

Location/Marketplace.title: Marketplace
Location/Marketplace.content:
A gathering place to trade various items. Always busy in the morning. name should change to fish market for unreasonable amount to fish monger.
Purpose: purchase and appraise items

Location/Quarry-Mine.title: Quarry Mine
Location/Quarry-Mine.content: Located a rocky terrain. Old man Jeofrey and his team do the mining for the living. also have copper and iron deposits.

Location/Tavern.title: Tavern
Location/Tavern.content:
located near the track to ocean. An inn for every tourist and serve the best seafood. Manage by the owner and his kid.
Purpose: villagers hang out space, info and rumor, food and sleep

Location/Town-Square.title: Town Square
Location/Town-Square.content:
Small community space at the middle of the town. All the town gathering is done at the square.
Purpose: kids playing, event and gathering

Location/Windfarm.title: Windfarm
Location/Windfarm.content: At the south from the lighthouse. Owned by the mayor’s friend and passed to his son. Manage by Mason brothers.

NPC/Elias-Varn.title: Elias Varn
NPC/Elias-Varn.content:
Elias Varn
Role:: Front-of-house at SeaSight Tavern
Age:: 26
Location:: SeaSight Tavern
Status:: No
Type:: NPC

Appearance
Salt-sprayed brown hair, sleeves always rolled up, leather apron

Character Trait
Friendly, sarcastic, carries emotional weight behind a calm facade

Background
Grew up in Townia and inherited the tavern business after his mother passed away. Secretly resents being “stuck” in town.

Recent Activity
Secrets
Keeps a journal of his dreams, which started becoming prophetic after the fog came.  Once saw a child’s face in the tavern mirror that wasn’t his own.

Quest
[Side Quest] “The Lost Menu”: Help him find a torn menu page that keeps disappearing.
[Main Quest Assist] Provides Charlotte with a flashlight or place to stay depending on choices.

Notes

Fog exposure: Yes
Memory loss: No

NPC/Old-Man-Jeofrey.title: Old Man Jeofrey
NPC/Old-Man-Jeofrey.content:
Old Man Jeofrey
Role:: Quarry Foreman
Age:: 43
Location:: Quarry
Status:: No
Type:: NPC

Appearance
Short, thick build, one eye cloudy from injury, copper tools on belt

Character Trait
Grumpy, grounded, logical

Background
A respected miner who discovered the “sealed tunnel” just before the fog came. Refuses to speak of what he saw.

Recent Activity
Dug out a stange tablet from new opening of the cave.
Secrets
Hides a fragment of carved stone in his home — a warning in a forgotten language.  Lost a brother to the mine years ago; claims he “heard him again” last week.

Quest
[Main Quest Trigger] Charlotte convinces him to reveal the sealed passage.  Optional dialogue reveals ancient town history.

Notes

Fog exposure: Yes
Memory loss: NO

NPC/Randal-Eaves.title: Randal Eaves
NPC/Randal-Eaves.content:
Randal Eaves
Role:: Lighthouse Keeper
Age:: 57
Location:: Lighthouse
Seen In:: 2025-07-22
Status:: No
Type:: NPC

Appearance
Gaunt face, permanently squinting from lighthouse glare, wears a fog cloak

Character Trait
Paranoid, cryptic, obsessive

Background
Ex-navy radio technician. Chose isolation. Hasn’t left the lighthouse in 4 months.

Recent Activity
Secrets
Claims the lighthouse isn’t for ships, but to ward off “those beneath.”  His log contains sketches of non-human vessels.

Quest
[Side Quest] “Signal Lost”: Retrieve his broken transmitter from the wind farm to hear a distress signal no one else believes in.  Shares lore about “ghost ships” and symbols that repel the fog.

Notes

Fog exposure: Yes
Memory loss: Yes

Town.title: Town
Town.content:
Townia, a port town built at the coastal valley. Sink toward to deep shoreline with an ocean filled with coastal and giant rock. Small boat won’t never have a chance to break through the wave, and the large one, halted by reef. The shore is covered by large mountain range from both east and west. Caves and caverns are form which too dangerous to explore.
Townia located at primary east side of the shore, with a beaming lighthouse on a cliff at west. A river ran across the town to the sea flowing from the mountains. A rocky terrain is present at the west of the town, supplying with quarry for building materials.
Townia has small population of about 300, with not much tourist footprint. people make a living out of shellfish from sea and fishing in river. It’s usually sunny and windy ith frequent rainstorm. there’re windmill at the outskirt of the town, provide enough electricity for the whole town. There’s a farm to the east of the town, providing with wheat and vegetation with their own watermill..
